title: One-person Content Studio - Re-creating Anthropic Commercial at Zero Cost
cardDesc: Full video production pipeline using open-source image and video generation models orchestrated through ComfyUI.

sections.title: Problem
items: Professional launch videos cost $3,000-$8,000 and take 4-8 weeks
DIY tools produce generic, forgettable content
Most founders don't know how to structure emotional narratives

sections.title: Solution
items: Built an 8-phase video production pipeline: Discover → Style → Storyboard → Images → Videos → Stitch → Audio → Export
Runs entirely on local DGX Spark hardware - no cloud GPU costs or API limits
ComfyUI orchestrates Flux (images) and Wan 2.2 (video animation) via custom TypeScript API client

sections.title: Technical Architecture
items: Next.js web app connects to ComfyUI server over local network (192.168.x.x:8188)
Custom ComfyUIClient: queues workflows via POST /prompt, polls /history/{id} for completion, fetches images via /view
Workflow injection: dynamically injects prompts into ComfyUI workflow JSON, randomizes seeds for variety
OpenRouter API for LLM calls (Phases 1-3), ElevenLabs for voiceover, Suno for music generation

sections.title: DGX Spark Specs
items: Grace Blackwell GB10 SoC with 128GB unified memory
6144 CUDA cores, 1 PFLOP NVFP4 AI performance
Runs Flux at full BF16 precision (~97s for 50 steps)
No quantization needed, can run multiple models simultaneously

sections.title: Result
items: Recreated Anthropic's 'Keep Thinking with Claude' video at 90% quality
Total time: under 2 hours from blank project to final export
Marginal cost per video approaching zero with local hardware
